d:
Patna Protest : patna men daroga bharti ki mukhy pariksha radd kie jane ke virodh men abhyarthiyon ka pradarshan jari hai. abhyarthi phaisle ko vapas lene aur bharti prakriya se juri mangon ko lekar sarak par utar aae hain. kaee abhyarthi gandhi maidan pahunch chuke hain. pradarshan ko dekhte hue pulis prashasan bhi alart hai.
Aakhir daroga bharti ki mukhy pariksha radd hone se abhyarthiyon men narajgi kyon hai? abhyarthi kya mang kar rahe hain aur pradarshan ko dekhte hue prashasan ki kya taiyari hai? dekhie patna se juri is khabar ki puri jankari.
